API.inputs: Detached FP64[S,G] raw_A / official score / Comfort; FP64[S,G,4] NC,DAC,TTC,EP. G8/G16. Official FP64 scores validated against current canonical formula; do not pass rounded FP32 reward labels.
API.output_device: CPU FP64; caller explicitly moves delta if needed

guards: Negative endpoint NC=DAC=TTC=Comfort=1, canonical>=.9, originalrawA<0; positive endpoint NC=DAC=TTC=1, rawA>0, strictly lower canonical. Each m=min(-A_high,A_lower), A_high+=m,A_lower-=m.
sorting: Exact previous replay: negative endpoint canonical descending/index ascending; positive endpoint canonical ascending/index ascending. Stable original candidate order resolves ties.
integration: Pure standalone module only. Future independently registered credit transform adds delta to A_EP/rawA, retains A_safe/rewards/mask/globalStd/original baseline normalization unless a separately registered specification explicitly says otherwise. No re-centering or normalization in this function. Fullpending/schema recovery integration remains future work; do not import into live baseline implicitly.
invariants: Unchanged input tensors; untouched output locations bitexact
Only strictly feasible positions change; no positive unsafe credit created
Group rawA sum conserved mathematically; measured FP64 rounding recorded rather than hidden by recentering
Negative-high candidates may remain after all lowercanonical positive mass is exhausted
Distinct from high-negative one-sided zeroing, which retains lowcanonical positive A and permits a positive groupmean
non_features: No automatic claim that raw credit sign equals parameter gradient or final score improvement
explanation_zh: 原16546个负high中2356个起初没有更低分正A见证，原样保留。其余14190个中9793个清零，4397个仍负（3510个部分减弱、887个在轮到前低分正优势已花完）。所以剩6753个负high，但任何一个都已无更低canonical的正A配对；规则取消反序符号组合，并不保证把每个绝对高分负A归零。
